sources.molar_mass: 3.0160293 g/mol, the atomic mass of helium-3: Wang et al., The AME 2020 atomic mass evaluation (II), Chinese Physics C 45 (2021) 030003, https://doi.org/10.1088/1674-1137/abddaf
sources.molar_heat_capacity: C_v = 3/2 R, a monatomic ideal gas. No NIST-JANAF table for helium-3 was found; helium-4's table gives the same value, 20.786 − 8.314 J/(mol·K). R: CODATA 2018, 8.314462618 J/(mol·K)
